prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, take and move. Else, approach or scan, then check properties. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO MoveToDestination
	END
